items.title: Aetheria
items.author: Joseph Lewis
items.note: November 2026. We wrote this book before we settled two rules our apps now follow: we make no claims about DNA, and we don't say a sound heals or cures. In places this book does both. It calls 528 Hz a tone for "DNA repair" (in Finding the Frequencies, The Architecture of Healing, The Three Regimes and the references), it calls DNA "a vibrational structure" (in The Language of Vibration), and it gives the Solfeggio tones healing names, such as pain relief for 174 Hz. Read those parts as where we were when we wrote them, not as claims. The rest is the book as printed. The Aetheria Tone Codex, on this shelf, has the names we use now.
